header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Petitioner Roshan Ali Azeem in person
body: Through this petition, the petitioner prays as under:a. Direct the authorities concerned should take serious actions to stop this expected outbreak of disease in peacock to save the beauty of Tharparkar. b. Direct the all respondent to clarify before this Honourable Court that how the disease come back again, and why they did not vaccinate to the peacocks.

c. Direct the all respondent to work for the breeding of peacocks. d. Cost of the petition may be saddled upon the respondents. e. Any other relief(s) which this Honourable Court deems fit, just and proper in favour of the petitioners.
Learned A.A.G submits that the respondents shall act strictly in accordance with law to redress the grievance of the petitioner.

In view of the above, this petition is disposed of with directions to the respondents to take immediate measures to save the peacocks (Pavo cristatus) from diseases and to make arrangements at the relevant areas where the peacocks are available in Sindh.
